CFML Language Reference: Functions

CreateUUID

Creates a Universally Unique Identifier (UUID): a value that is, for all practical purposes, different from every other UUID ever generated, on any machine.

Category

Other functions

Syntax

CreateUUID()

Returns

A string of 35 characters in the format XXXXXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX (8-4-4-16 hexadecimal digits).

Usage

UUIDs make good unique keys when several servers insert records, and good unguessable file names. Note the format: four groups of 8, 4, 4 and 16 digits, not the five groups used by Microsoft's GUIDs.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>No.</TH><TH>CreateUUID()</TH><TH>Len</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="4">
  <CFSET ID = CreateUUID()>
  <CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#i#</TD><TD><TT>#ID#</TT></TD><TD>#Len(ID)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
